title: VPORT DWG encoder allocation rollback and retry
scope: Generated local VPORT direct-codec transaction control across legacy inline, detached, separate, and aliased stream layouts

implementation.behavior: Catch allocation failures in ambient CMC preflight and body encoding; stage distinct body, string, and handle destinations; publish only after all writes succeed. Preserve angle conversion, aspect-ratio normalization, revision-specific UCS/grid fields, resource handle roles, and typed-null behavior. Public and typed writer routes share the staged implementation.

control.profile: Locally generated VPORT with two reactors, extension dictionary, nondefault view geometry and angles, xref/UCS references, and modern background/visual-style/sun references.
control.failure_assertions: Every reached one-shot allocation failure leaves caller body, strings, handles, cursors, health, and handle-occurrence ledgers unchanged. The same object and buffers then retry to clean output.

validation.build: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dwg_object_encoder_allocation_tests libdxfrw_dwg_object_vectors_tests libdxfrw_dwg_vport_angle_units_tests dwg2dxf libdxfrw_dxf_fixture_tests -j2
validation.result: The allocation control reports all seven layouts passing rollback/retry across 144 offsets. All six focused CTests passed.

limits: Generated local transaction evidence only; it does not extend VPORT producer/version support claims.
The typed-null writer route shares the staged implementation but was not separately fault-injected in this receipt.
Native viewport rendering, whole-source completeness, and broader graph closure remain open.
